correctness.rationale: Read the complete exact proof in the assigned RESULT.md. The leaf identity E L(G)=sum_v deg(v)tau(G-v)/tau(G) is a direct leaf-edge bijection. Orthogonal deleted matching edges and the r-star Laplacian eigenvalues give the two tree enumerators, and vertex deletion gives both normalized leaf formulas. The inequalities follow strictly from Bernoulli for matching and Jensen for star, with the n=2r and r=1 boundary handled. Independently checked exact rational comparison for n=4,5,6,8 across valid r. The finite checks complement the all-n algebra.
